about.description: Phoenix V is a family-friendly beachfront condo complex in Orange Beach offering 1-, 2-, and 3-bedroom vacation rentals with direct beach access and Gulf-front views. Located close to dining, shopping, and attractions in both Orange Beach and Gulf Shores, Phoenix V is designed for families and groups looking for space, convenience, and resort-style amenities. All units feature Gulf views from expansive private balconies, floor-to-ceiling windows, and open living areas.
about.elevator_pitch: Beachfront family-friendly condo resort in Orange Beach with 1-3 bedroom units, direct beach access, multiple pools, splash pad, and resort amenities.
